purpose: Gate 4-7 pi-tui migration behavior and e2e smoke scenarios
automationScope: no-external-service PTY smoke; deep app workflows still require verification-record evidence

steps: Start the built CLI TUI in a real terminal or PTY
Type regular text and verify it is displayed in the editor
Press Enter and verify submit behavior
Use Shift+Enter and verify newline insertion
Use Tab and Shift+Tab in slash completion or form navigation
Verify Ctrl+J behavior is either compatible or documented as an accepted migration difference
assertions: Main input remains focused after non-terminal key events
Submit and newline behavior are not swapped
Autocomplete accepts the selected item without corrupting surrounding text

steps: Open Permission, askUser, exitPlanMode, notice, and task switcher prompts
Navigate with Up, Down, PageUp, PageDown, Tab, and Shift+Tab
Confirm with Enter and cancel with Escape or Ctrl+C
Close each prompt and verify focus returns to the expected owner
assertions: No prompt steals focus from a higher priority prompt
Closing an overlay restores focus and does not leave the main editor disabled
Long prompt content can scroll without losing the selected item

steps: Open Calendar TUI, navigate dates and details, then close with Escape or q
Open Mailbox TUI, navigate list/detail/editing regions, then close with Escape or q
assertions: Application TUI pages respond to navigation and close keys
Release events are ignored where only press events should be handled
Closing application TUI pages returns to the main input
scenarios.manualEvidenceRequired: Deep Calendar and Mailbox flows that depend on real accounts or business data must be recorded in tui_migration_verification_record.md.

steps: Open Skill Manager TUI, navigate list/search/action prompts, then close
Open Channel Manager TUI, navigate list/install/cancel prompts, then close
assertions: SelectList based pages preserve selection across navigation
Confirm and cancel flows do not leave nested prompts active
Main input is usable after leaving the application TUI
scenarios.automationNote: Automated smoke opens the Skill Manager entry and navigation path without external services. Channel Manager install/list flows require separate verification-record evidence.

steps: Run at 80x24, 120x30, and 160x40
Resize the same running PTY while output is streaming and verify redraw evidence
Enter Chinese text through IME and verify width handling
Render markdown lists, code blocks, links, ANSI colored text, and long streaming output
Exercise Backspace, Ctrl+Backspace, Shift+Enter, Ctrl+Enter, and Ctrl+J
assertions: No crash, stale line, visible control sequence, or broken cursor marker appears
CJK text does not corrupt wrapping or cursor placement
Keyboard protocol differences are recorded with terminal name and version
scenarios.automationNote: Automated smoke uses controlledTermination after CJK/ANSI rendering and dynamic PTY resize evidence are captured so the test text is not submitted as an LLM task.

steps: Collect each known intermittent TUI crash report ID or source before migration closure
Run the same functional scenario set repeatedly before migration and record crash count
Run the same functional scenario set repeatedly after migration and record crash count
Classify each remaining crash as pi-tui migration regression, OpenDesk adaptation issue, upstream issue, environmental issue, or unrelated
assertions: The same functional assertions pass before and after migration
No crash, uncaught exception, unhandled rejection, terminal reset failure, or nonzero process exit occurs during the repeated smoke loop
No migration closure is allowed with an untriaged crash report
